title: OPENINGBALANCEWEEK uses the last date of the week before
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "open", OPENINGBALANCEWEEK ( [Total], Weekly ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2008, 8, 14 ) )

source.quote: OPENINGBALANCEWEEK evaluates Expression at the last date of the previous week, as the calendar defines the week.

derivation: August 14 is in W33-2008 (August 10 to 16); the week before is August 3 to 9; its last date, August 9, has Amount 9.
